title: german paneer braunfleisch
description: a hearty, earthy dish that combines paneer cheese with caramelized onions and pickled red cabbage. this german-inspired meal is perfect for a cozy evening in with family or friends.
instructions: heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
add sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they're dark golden brown and caramelized, about 20 minutes.
add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
slowly add beef broth and white wine, whisking constantly, and bring to a simmer.
add paneer cheese and cook until it's melted and the mixture is smooth.
season with salt and black pepper to taste.
serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley and pickled red cabbage.
use a high-quality beef broth for the best flavor.
don't overcook the onions, or they'll become bitter.
add a sprinkle of parsley on top of each serving for a pop of color and freshness.
